question: Should OpenClaw support AG-UI as a bundled, published channel with its new public configuration defaults and gateway HTTP surface, rather than defer it until an external-channel distribution model is established?
rationale: The code can be reviewed mechanically, but accepting a new bundled channel fixes a durable product, packaging, dependency, and support boundary that cannot be inferred from implementation quality alone.

options.title: Sponsor the bundled channel
options.body: Accept AG-UI as a supported bundled channel, authorize the reviewed dependency graph through the required security path, and require final fresh-package proof before merge.

options.title: Defer to an external-channel model
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define and support an external channel distribution seam that can host AG-UI without bundling it into the core package.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bundled channel
recommendation.body: Accept AG-UI as a supported bundled channel, authorize the reviewed dependency graph through the required security path, and require final fresh-package proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The immediate merge blocker is the required authorization for the dependency graph; channel owners should join the broader distribution decision.
